title.zh: ISO 42001 AI 治理戰略與合規匯報 (高階管理層視角)

slide_title.zh: 商業脈絡與治理訴求 (SCQA & The Ask)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：企業正加速擁抱 AI 以提升競爭力，各部門已出現初步應用
衝突 (Complication)：缺乏統一規範導致「影子 AI (Shadow AI)」蔓延，資料外洩與合規風險遽增
解答與訴求 (Answer & The Ask)：啟動 ISO 42001 AIMS 導入，懇請董事會授權第一階段治理預算與跨部門推動權限
en: Situation: The enterprise is accelerating AI adoption for competitive advantage across departments.
Complication: Lack of unified guardrails has led to 'Shadow AI', drastically increasing data and compliance risks.
Answer & The Ask: Initiate ISO 42001 AIMS. Requesting Board authorization for Phase 1 budget and cross-functional mandate.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位董事好。擁抱 AI 是必然的趨勢，但目前各部門自發性的「影子 AI」應用，已經讓公司暴露在極大的隱私與合規風險中。今天的提案，是為了在創新與風險之間建立護欄，透過導入 ISO 42001，確保我們的 AI 應用合法、安全且可控。
speaker_notes.en: Members of the Board, while AI adoption is essential, unregulated 'Shadow AI' usage currently exposes us to severe privacy and compliance risks. Today's proposal establishes guardrails between innovation and risk via ISO 42001, ensuring our AI initiatives are lawful, safe, and governed.

slide_title.zh: AI 風險雷達與不作為成本 (Risk-based Thinking)
slide_title.en: AI Risk Radar & Cost of Inaction (Risk-based Thinking)

zh: 合規與商譽風險：若觸犯 [當地 AI 法案/GDPR]，面臨高額罰款與品牌信任度重挫
AI 生命週期風險：涵蓋模型開發期的偏見 (Bias) 注入，到部署期的幻覺 (Hallucination) 決策
預防 ROI (Data Literacy)：建立 AIMS 的合規成本，僅佔潛在違規罰款與補救成本的 [X]%
en: Regulatory & Reputational Risk: Breaching [AI Acts/GDPR] leads to massive fines and shattered brand trust.
AI Lifecycle Risks: From Bias injection during development to Hallucination-driven decisions during deployment.
Prevention ROI: The cost of implementing AIMS is merely [X]% of potential fines and remediation costs.

speaker_notes.zh: 我們採用風險導向思維來檢視現狀。在 AI 的生命週期中，從開發到部署都充滿地雷。不作為的隱含成本極高，相比之下，投資合規治理的 ROI 是非常明確的，這是保護公司資產的最有效防線。
speaker_notes.en: Applying risk-based thinking, the AI lifecycle is fraught with landmines from development to deployment. The hidden cost of inaction is enormous. In contrast, the ROI of investing in compliance governance is clear—it is the most effective defense for our corporate assets.

slide_title.zh: MECE 治理框架與控制落地 (Governance Controls)

zh: 政策與標準 (Policy)：發布《企業可信賴 AI 準則》，明訂資料分類與 AI 容許使用場景
系統與技術 (Tech)：針對高風險 AI 系統強制實施「人工監督 (Human Oversight)」與存取控制
人員與當責 (People)：指派 AI 治理負責人，確立跨部門 RACI 矩陣，確保究責無死角
en: Policy & Standards: Publish 'Trustworthy AI Guidelines' defining data classification and permissible AI use cases.
Tech & Systems: Mandate 'Human Oversight' and strict access controls for all high-risk AI applications.
People & Accountability: Appoint an AI Governance Lead and establish a cross-functional RACI matrix.

speaker_notes.zh: 針對風險，我們設計了不重疊、不遺漏 (MECE) 的控制措施。不僅有政策面的規範，在系統面我們也強制介入了人工監督機制。最重要的是「人員與當責」，確保每一個 AI 專案都有明確的負責人，杜絕灰色地帶。
speaker_notes.en: To mitigate these risks, we've designed MECE controls. Beyond policy formulation, we are mandating human oversight mechanisms at the system level. Most importantly, we focus on 'People & Accountability' to ensure every AI project has clear ownership, eliminating gray areas.

slide_title.zh: 內部稽核與績效監控 (Audit & Performance Metrics)

zh: 指標定義 (KPIs)：追蹤高風險 AI 系統的合規覆蓋率、透明度指標與異常通報處理時效
稽核準備 (Audit)：規劃於 [月份] 啟動 ISO 42001 內部稽核，執行全面的落差分析 (Gap Analysis)
動態評估 (Continuous Evaluation)：隨法規與技術演進，每季度重新校準風險胃納量 (Risk Appetite)
en: Governance KPIs: Track compliance coverage for high-risk AI, transparency metrics, and incident response times.
Audit Readiness: Launching ISO 42001 internal audit in [Month] to conduct a comprehensive Gap Analysis.
Continuous Evaluation: Recalibrate the organizational Risk Appetite quarterly to align with evolving AI laws and tech.

speaker_notes.zh: 治理不是一次性專案，而是持續的監控。我們設定了量化的治理 KPI，並準備在幾個月後進行嚴格的內部稽核。同時，由於 AI 技術與法規變動極快，我們會定期重新評估公司的風險胃納量，保持敏捷。
speaker_notes.en: Governance is not a one-off project but continuous monitoring. We have established quantitative governance KPIs and will conduct a rigorous internal audit soon. Given the rapid evolution of AI tech and regulations, we will frequently recalibrate our risk appetite to remain agile.

slide_title.zh: 變革管理與期望管理 (Change Mgmt & Next Steps)

zh: 人員賦能 (Change Mgmt)：不只防堵風險，更透過全員 AI 素養培訓，引導安全、創新的應用
期望管理 (Managing Up)：第一階段聚焦於高風險系統納管，承諾 [日期] 前完成基準線建立
行動決策 (Call to Action)：請董事會核准第一階段 [金額] 預算及跨部門推動授權
en: People Empowerment (Change Mgmt): Beyond mitigating risk, rolling out AI literacy training to drive safe innovation.
Expectation Management: Phase 1 strictly focuses on corralling high-risk systems; baseline established by [Date].
Call to Action: Request Board approval for the Phase 1 budget of [X] and cross-functional enforcement mandate.

speaker_notes.zh: 最終，落實治理的關鍵在於「人」。我們會在嚴格管控的同時，推動變革管理，提升全員的 AI 素養。在期望管理上，我們初期會先聚焦解決最高風險的項目。如果各位對此方向沒有異議，希望能取得正式的授權與預算。
speaker_notes.en: Ultimately, effective governance relies on 'People'. Alongside strict controls, we will drive change management to elevate enterprise AI literacy. In managing expectations, our initial phase focuses purely on resolving the highest-risk items. If the Board agrees with this direction, we respectfully request formal authorization and budget.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份專業的『ISO 42001 AI 管理系統導入與治理』簡報。受眾為董事會或高階管理層。內容必須展現 AIGP 等級的專業視野，著重於：1. 運用 SCQA 架構說明影子 AI 的風險，2. 將合規視為投資，凸顯預防風險的 ROI，3. 提出 MECE 結構的控制措施（涵蓋政策、技術、人員當責），4. 強調變革管理 (Change Management) 與人員賦能。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，每字不超過一行，語氣需具備高度的戰略視野、風險意識與推動跨部門合作的領導力。
prompt_template.en: Please create a professional 'ISO 42001 AIMS Implementation & Governance' presentation in English. Audience: Board of Directors or C-Suite. Demonstrate an AIGP-level professional perspective by focusing on: 1. SCQA framing to address 'Shadow AI' risks, 2. Highlighting the ROI of compliance and proactive risk mitigation, 3. Proposing MECE controls (covering Policy, Tech, and People/Accountability), 4. Emphasizing Change Management and employee empowerment. Max 3 bullet points per slide, max one line per bullet. The tone must be highly strategic, risk-aware, and demonstrate strong leadership for cross-functional alignment.
